children: (TheNewswire)
Also Announces Change to IR Provider

Vancouver, Canada – September 11, 2026 – TheNewswire -  Redwood AI Corp. (CSE: AIRX) (OTCQB: RDWCF) (Frankfurt: Y0N, WKN: A422EZ) ("Redwood" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has been featured in two publications issued through Life Sciences British Columbia’s ("Life Sciences BC" or "LSBC") Growth Catalyst Program, including the program booklet, A Look Inside the Growth Catalyst Program Companies, and Issue No. 2 of the Growth Catalyst Program Quarterly Newsletter. The features profile Redwood’s application of specialized artificial intelligence to chemistry, drug development and related scientific applications

The Growth Catalyst Program booklet includes a two-page Redwood profile1 titled “Cutting delays in drug development with AI,” which describes the Company’s use of proprietary AI models to help chemists design, optimize and plan more efficient chemical reaction pathways. The profile discusses Redwood’s use of millions of data points, including reaction data, safety considerations, material costs and logistics variables, to provide actionable recommendations to chemists. It also identifies opportunities for the Company’s technology in adjacent chemical areas, including hazardous material detection and defence applications.

Redwood was also profiled in the Summer 2026 edition of the Growth Catalyst Program Quarterly Newsletter in a dedicated feature titled “Redwood AI: Why Specialized AI May Be the Next Frontier in Life Sciences.”2 The feature examines Redwood’s development of specialized AI models trained on chemical data and discusses applications across pharmaceutical manufacturing, chemical safety and public-sector initiatives.

The Growth Catalyst Program, supported by Pacific Economic Development Canada ("PacifiCan"), is designed to support the expansion of high-growth B.C.-based life sciences companies through educational opportunities, mentorship, support for international conferences and investor engagement. Life Sciences BC also reports that its weekly Events & BioLinks newsletters reach more than 3,500 subscribers.3

“We are pleased to see Redwood’s work featured through two Life Sciences BC Growth Catalyst Program publications. These features provide an opportunity to share our approach to specialized AI with a broad life sciences audience and demonstrate how purpose-built technology can be applied to complex challenges in chemistry, drug development and chemical safety. We appreciate the work Life Sciences BC is doing to support the growth and visibility of B.C.-based companies and to connect them with the broader life sciences ecosystem,” stated Louis Dron, Chief Executive Officer of Redwood AI.

The Company also announces that it has cancelled its previously-disclosed IR engagement (see Company press releases dated August 10, May 5 and February 20, 2026), and obtained a return of funds in the amount of CAD$588,285.

The Company announces that it has now engaged Frontier Media Inc. (1500-1874 Scarth Street, Regina, Saskatchewan, Canada S4P 4E9; email: jordan@frontiermediainc.ca; telephone: 306-530-7746; Contact: Jordan Madill) to provide market awareness and corporate communications services, including through content creation, project management, third-party media distribution, and digital market awareness initiatives. The investor relations and market awareness activities will be conducted through digital and online channels, including search-based advertising, display advertising, remarketing campaigns, campaign-specific landing pages and third-party online media, advertising and distribution channels.

The initial market awareness budget under the agreement with Frontier Media Inc. is CAD $600,000. The program is scheduled to run until January 11, 2027, or budget exhaustion, and is structured to allow for ongoing evaluation and optimization based on market conditions. The Company believes that maintaining consistent, compliant market awareness is an important component of supporting visibility, and long-term shareholder base development.
To the Company’s knowledge, Frontier Media Inc.  does not have any interest, directly or indirectly, in the securities of the Company.
About Redwood AI Corp.

Redwood AI is a technology company developing advanced artificial intelligence and cybersecurity solutions for defence, public safety and life sciences. The Company applies artificial intelligence across quantum cybersecurity, scientific research and advanced chemistry applications. Redwood AI’s technology is designed to help organizations prepare for quantum-enabled cybersecurity threats while enabling faster, more efficient development of new therapies and chemistry-driven applications.
